item.title: Libya braces for Mediterranean storm Agnetta
item.description: The storm is centered south of Italy and moving east with active winds and low pressure.

item.title: Libya council discusses delayed school year

item.title: Libya parliament to debate unified public sector pay scale
item.description: Teachers demand action as lawmakers review salary legislation that has exposed divisions among public employees.
